title: Go Out With Joy
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who keeps looking until the thing turns up, and tonight Isaiah says to seek the Lord while He may be found: one green boot, a whole morning of searching, and then two boots stomping down the hallway singing, because seeking ends in gladness.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because seeking is how joy gets found. In Scout’s world today: Scout hunted all morning for his missing green boot. He looked under the beds, behind the doors, and inside the laundry basket. When it finally turned up in the coat closet, he stomped both boots down the hallway singing. Just like the people promised they would go out with joy, Scout learned that seeking ends in gladness.
